breaking_news.headline: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
breaking_news.summary: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.

breaking_news.headline: Former State Department energy envoy on how the war in Iran is impacting gas prices
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to former State Department energy envoy David Goldwyn about how the war in Iran continues to affect gas and diesel prices.

breaking_news.headline: Trump issues new executive orders on beef sales to pacify American cattle ranchers
breaking_news.summary: President Trump's latest executive orders allows ranchers to sell meat directly to consumers. Ranchers have been upset over Trump's plan to boost beef imports in a bid to lower prices.

breaking_news.headline: Union electricians welcome data center boom
breaking_news.summary: The boom in data centers has brought plenty of work and lots of overtime to union electricians, putting them at odds with many communities trying to block new data center construction.

breaking_news.headline: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
breaking_news.summary: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

breaking_news.headline: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
breaking_news.summary: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to.

breaking_news.headline: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
breaking_news.summary: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now.

breaking_news.headline: A new Anthropic model seeks to test how AI could impact the U.S. economy
breaking_news.summary: Will artificial intelligence nibble around the edges of the economy or upend it altogether? A new, interactive model from Anthropic lets people tests their assumptions.

breaking_news.headline: Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages
breaking_news.summary: Three deaths are reported in Ukraine and four in Russia as both sides launch new drone strikes.

breaking_news.headline: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief
breaking_news.summary: The decision, announced by the chief of defence, comes just two months after Uganda said it would participate.

breaking_news.headline: N Korea has built two-storey uranium enrichment facility, says watchdog
breaking_news.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency's says the facility is cause for "serious concern".

breaking_news.headline: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
breaking_news.summary: The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings were among those who attended proceedings on Wednesday.

breaking_news.headline: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
breaking_news.summary: It is the latest strike in a long trade war, and comes after Canadian counter-tariffs on US goods come into force.

breaking_news.headline: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
breaking_news.summary: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday

breaking_news.headline: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
breaking_news.summary: The US tech giant says the €13bn data centre project will create tens of thousands of jobs.

breaking_news.headline: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
breaking_news.summary: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.

breaking_news.headline: I'm 27 and I've already written my will - here's why
breaking_news.summary: For many young people making a will may not seem necessary, but here's why you shouldn't put it off.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic researcher believes more than 10% chance AI 'could kill all humans'
breaking_news.summary: It is the latest in a series of increasing warnings about the safety threat posed by artificial intelligence.

breaking_news.headline: Should promotion depend on how workers use AI?
breaking_news.summary: More companies are tying career progression to AI use: is that fair?
